capabilities: collect all checkbox tasks in the vault into one panel with Today, Upcoming and Inbox presets
filter, sort and group tasks by status, due date, priority, tag or heading
complete, reschedule and edit tasks from the panel, writing changes back as plain Markdown
quick-add tasks in natural language with dates, times, repeats, priorities and tags
set recurring rules and reminders for timed tasks
disambiguation: Not just a read-only task list; it also creates, edits, completes and reschedules tasks in the underlying notes.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes network/privacy disclosures (no network use, no account or telemetry) and describes BRAT installation.
problem: Obsidian's core Task lists only render checkboxes inside notes and offers no single panel to see, filter, schedule or complete all tasks across the vault.

relations.evidence: An independent project, ported from the tasks feature of Starnote.

summary: Task panel that collects every checkbox task in the vault into Today, Upcoming and Inbox views, with filters, grouping, recurring tasks, reminders and a query language.
